# image-pipeline-configurability-reanalysis — analysis (generated by analyst on 2026-08-09)

## Problem

RE-ANALYSIS of M1-798 (setup-wizard /image step) under a changed brief. Two
facts define the problem:

1. **The original gap stands.** D73 makes `/image` exist only when
   `infochat.image.base-url` is configured; the setup wizard is the supported
   configuration path, and its STEPS list (prod/setup.sh:23-33) registers nine
   steps, none touching image generation — probe re-run on main 2026-08-09:
   `grep -n image prod/setup.sh` → no match. The D73 gate can never open for
   a wizard-installed deployment.
2. **The brief changed.** M1-798 was drafted 2026-08-08 from the 2026-08-07
   design addendum. On 2026-08-09 a container measurement spike on the Strix
   Halo (gfx1151) box settled the pipeline-configurability question; the
   durable record is the "Addendum 2026-08-09 — pipeline configurability" in
   docs/design/future/image-generation.md, and its "Final decisions
   2026-08-09 (v1 scope, user-approved)" items 1–7 (design doc :749-793) are
   the authority. They change what the wizard step must write: NO diffusion
   upscaler in v1 (PiD broken on AMD upstream — Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#14273;
   ESRGAN family +22–45 s on gfx1151), a VAE picker for Krea (krea2RealVae
   recommended / stock fallback), the spacepxl 2× VAE-decode fit stage for
   Krea (needs the MIT ComfyUI-VAE-Utils custom node in the M1-797 image),
   per-model diffusion steps BAKED into the templates (Mage 4 / Z-Image 8 /
   Krea 6 @ 0.6 MP), new container numbers, license printing for community
   assets, and an ETA constant that is a wizard probe of the FINAL template,
   not a table lookup.

The stale worktree implementation (`.claude/worktrees/M1-798`, zero commits)
was written to the OLD brief; mechanics largely survive, content does not
(§Prior art disposition). The rewritten ticket must stand on the new brief
alone.

## Root cause

Feature gap plus a changed brief, not a code defect. (1) The wizard is the
single registration point for setup steps (prod/setup.sh:19-22), so the D73
gate stays closed until an image step exists. (2) The 2026-08-09 spike
decisions changed what that step must write — template content (steps, VAEs,
fit stage), picker content (VAE choice, new numbers, license labels), and the
ETA mechanism (probe of the FINAL template, not a lookup) — so the drafted
ticket and its stale worktree implementation no longer describe the work.
(3) The spacepxl fit stage needs a custom node the M1-797 image does not
carry (Dockerfile verified node-free), which is a prerequisite carve.

## Pitfalls

Numbering continues from docs/plan/m1/tick-analysis/image-generation-feature.md
(P1..P25); P26+ are new. Carried pitfalls are the ones this decomposition
touches.

- **P15 (carried): template integrity is the RCE-facing property.** The
  endpoint executes submitted graphs (D77); the wizard now AUTHORS templates.
  Each must carry exactly one `INFOCHAT_PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER` text field and
  exactly one KSampler with a numeric seed — the exact contract
  ComfyUIClient enforces at Provider boot (ComfyUIClient.java:483-524). The
  negative prompt stays static baked text in its own CLIPTextEncode, never a
  second placeholder. A template that fails validation makes the Provider
  refuse boot (:91) — loud, but still a wizard defect.
- **P21 (carried): container/flag discipline.** No host port in the overlay
  (security.md §Trust boundaries item 8 precedent); the launch flags are
  measured requirements, not tunables (Dockerfile:5-7) — the node carve
  RE-VERIFIES them, never re-tunes them; the wizard's compose invocations
  feed secrets via `--env-file`, never shell-source (M1-389).
- **P22 (carried): wizard honesty.** Local install offered only on
  GPU-capable profiles (never pi/vps — 1-profile.sh:11); ONLY container
  numbers printed as container numbers; preflight (HEAD every asset URL,
  disk, memory) before any multi-GB download; qwen3vl_4b encoder dedupe;
  D77 firewall requirement printed on the two-box path; disk demand printed
  BEFORE commit — now including the two new Krea VAE files (their sizes are
  not in the committed record: measure and record, don't estimate).
- **P24 (carried): model files are operator assets.** The delete-previous-
  model offer on switch names model files only (never anything else), skips
  every blob the NEW install shares (encoder AND VAE files now), and is not
  part of the D75 no-content chain.
- **P26 (new): conda-vs-container for the VAE lever numbers (D-1).**
  22.14/22.54 s were conda-env measurements (design doc :734). Presenting
  them as container numbers repeats exactly the trap P22 was written for
  (M1-797 acceptance: "no conda number may be presented as a container
  number"). The picker prints the container table; the ETA constant comes
  from the live container probe, so no static VAE-lever number reaches the
  written config.
- **P27 (new): community-asset license honesty.** Both VAE weights are
  license-UNDECLARED on HuggingFace (design doc :744-747); the wizard prints
  them as community assets with that label (same posture as the curated
  tiers), and the ComfyUI-VAE-Utils repo as MIT. Never claim a license the
  HF card does not state — the project selects curated assets on license
  sanity (future-features.md §B2 records Mage-Flow's MIT).
- **P28 (new): the Krea decode/fit wiring is an ASSUMPTION (D-3).** The
  committed record settles WHAT ships (both VAE files, the MIT node, picker
  labels, fit-stage decisions) but not the exact node wiring of the one
  baked Krea template. Resolution path: the spike graphs if they survive
  (/tmp/opencode/img-measure/graphs/*.json), else the spacepxl node docs +
  fblissjr/krea-explorations; the proof is EXECUTION — the ETA probe
  generation runs the FINAL template in the deployment container and a
  mis-wired graph fails it. M1-807's 2× decode probe de-risks the node half
  before the wizard starts.
- **P29 (new): measurement-protocol traps in the ETA probe.** A fixed seed
  measures ComfyUI's node cache, not generation (M1-797 recorded a 0.21 s
  cache hit); the first run after a model/config switch leaks autotune cost
  (Z-Image 28.64 vs 22.37 steady — handoff §7). The probe is warm-up +
  five timed runs, UNIQUE seed per run, warm-up discarded — the M1-797
  protocol.
- **P30 (new, carried from review finding 1): the remote path writes no ETA
  constant.** The constant is a measurement on the deployment's own backend;
  the remote path runs no probe against the entered URL, so writing the
  Strix-Halo number there would make every M1-803 progress-message ETA a lie
  measured on different hardware. Remote is the ONLY enable path on pi/vps —
  the common case for half the profiles. Unset → position without ETA
  (M1-803 acceptance item 12's recorded resolution).
- **P31 (new, carried from review finding 2): do_reset must learn the
  comfyui overlay.** The step starts a container with `restart:
  unless-stopped` and a 56g cap; do_reset probes/downs the base file only
  (prod/setup.sh:171, :207), so `--reset` would leave the GPU container
  running through a documented full teardown — breaking the M1-395 invariant
  written into do_reset (:156-165: reset stops every service the wizard may
  have started). §10: the reset contract is an incidental obligation of the
  path this change extends.
- **P32 (carried from the worktree review's RECOMMENDED-NEW-TICKET): the
  template mount's auto-created directory.** docker-compose.yml mounts
  ./prod/runtime/comfyui-workflow.json into the Provider; a compose up
  before step 4b runs auto-creates a DIRECTORY at the source. The write side
  is defeated (rmdir before write — prior art, falsification-verified in
  review); the residual — whether an already-created Provider container
  whose bind mount was established while the source was a directory picks up
  the file across `apps.sh restart` — could not be falsified offline and is
  DECIDE-BEFORE M1-803 (its end-to-end flow is the first real consumer).
- **P33 (new, M1-807): supply-chain pin.** ComfyUI-VAE-Utils enters the
  backend image — the endpoint is code execution on the hosting box (D77),
  so image code is security surface. The node is installed at a PINNED
  commit (the COMFYUI_COMMIT precedent, Dockerfile:15), MIT-licensed only
  (Final decision 5), and nothing else: the REJECTED list stands (no
  SUPIR-class, no UltimateSDUpscale-class custom nodes — design doc :790-793).
- **P34 (new, M1-807): re-verification discipline.** The flag re-verify
  runs the M1-797 protocol with its PASS threshold (Mage-Flow container
  steady state within 2× conda 4.38 s) plus a real Krea + spacepxl 2×
  decode generation asserting ~2× output dimensions. If the node's presence
  breaks the measured stack, ESCALATE — never silently re-tune flags that
  are measured requirements (Dockerfile:5-7, §2/§6).

## Solution options

1. **Chosen: two tickets — M1-807 (image carve) + M1-798 (wizard rewrite).**
   Different surfaces (image build vs. wizard shell/docs), independently
   verifiable, hard dependency in one direction only (the wizard's Krea
   template and ETA probe need the node in the image). Matches the Final
   decision 5 wording ("a small carve … rides with it or lands as its own
   ticket per the re-analysis").
2. **Fold the carve into M1-798 (one ticket).** Rejected: one ticket would
   touch the Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (mount), prod/setup.sh (STEPS +
   do_reset), a new ~700-line step script, SETUP_GUIDE.md, and
   07-deployment.md — more than a handful of files (decomposition failure),
   and the carve's live flag re-verification would tangle with the wizard's
   live probes in one acceptance surface.
3. **Ship without the spacepxl node (lanczos-only fit, zero image change).**
   Rejected: user-approved Final decision 5 ships spacepxl 2× in v1,
   accepting the image re-validation and the undeclared-weight risk.
4. **Runtime pipeline configurability (steps/fit as per-job inputs).**
   Rejected: addendum decision 3 — setup-time, baked by the wizard, never
   runtime; change = re-run the step (the model-switch shape).
5. **ETA constant as a table lookup from the spike numbers.** Rejected:
   brief gain 4 — the constant is a wizard probe of the FINAL template
   (steps + VAE + fit stage baked); a lookup would also reopen P30 on the
   local path (the table has no row for the operator's exact template).

## Chosen approach

Option 1. Spec refs per decision: D73 (config gate opened by the wizard —
decisions.md:92), D77 (one-box compose-network form + two-box firewall
disclosure — decisions.md:96; security.md §Trust boundaries item 8), the
design doc's Final decisions 2026-08-09 (design layer, user-approved —
docs/design/future/image-generation.md:749-793).

**Wizard→handler interface the rewrite establishes (for M1-803's analysis):**

- Config keys written by step 4b: `infochat.image.base-url` (local:
  `http://comfyui:8188`; remote: operator URL), `infochat.image.workflow-file`
  (`/app/comfyui-workflow.json`, the Provider's bind mount),
  `infochat.image.steady-state-seconds` (LOCAL path only: the probe's
  steady-state mean; remote leaves it UNSET — P30), `infochat.image.model`
  (tier id, re-run/switch detection). All four already appear in M1-803's
  acceptance item 12 and the prior-art script; none exists in Java yet
  except base-url/workflow-file (ComfyUIClient.java:96-97).
- Template content: one API-format graph per model; exactly one
  INFOCHAT_PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER text field + exactly one KSampler with numeric
  seed (the M1-802 validation contract); per-model steps baked (4/8/6);
  per-model VAE + fit stage baked (Krea: spacepxl 2× decode + lanczos exact
  fit; Mage/Z-Image: VAEDecode + lanczos exact fit via ImageScale); latent
  and fit dimensions baked NUMERIC so the serializer can set them. NOTE for
  M1-803: buildGraph today parameterizes only prompt + seed
  (ComfyUIClient.java:116-128) — the converter's per-job latent/fit dims
  (design doc :899-901) and the DECIDE-BEFORE of addendum decision 4 (how
  the handler learns the baked sampling budget; candidate: one more key
  written by this step) are M1-803's to settle; if it needs a template or
  key change, its own ticket amends the step.
- ETA constant: warm-up + five timed generations of the FINAL template
  against the deployment's own container, unique seeds, warm-up discarded,
  steady-state mean written (P29).
- Mount: docker-compose.yml Provider service gains
  `./prod/runtime/comfyui-workflow.json:/app/comfyui-workflow.json:ro`;
  absent until step 4b runs; write side rmdirs an auto-created directory
  (P32); the bind-mount-across-restart residual is M1-803's DECIDE-BEFORE.

**Files-to-touch plan and order:**

- **M1-807 first** (files: prod/images/comfyui/Dockerfile,
  docs/design/future/image-generation.md): pinned-commit install of
  ComfyUI-VAE-Utils → rebuild → node-registration probe → flag re-verify
  (M1-797 protocol + threshold) → Krea + spacepxl 2× decode generation probe
  → record in the design doc. Order rationale: the node must exist in the
  image before any Krea template can execute, and the re-verification is the
  gate Final decision 5 conditions the ship on.
- **M1-798 second** (files: prod/scripts/4b-image.sh (new), prod/setup.sh
  (STEPS entry + do_reset overlay fix), docker-compose.yml (template mount),
  SETUP_GUIDE.md (section), docs/design/07-deployment.md (§7.7.2 step-table
  row + mount seam), docs/design/future/image-generation.md (measured Krea
  VAE sizes for the disk table)). Order inside the ticket: step script →
  STEPS registration + do_reset fix → compose mount → docs → probes. The
  script exists before its registration (a registered-but-missing script
  breaks the wizard loop; a present-but-unregistered script is merely
  orphaned).

## Controls to preserve (engineering-rules §10)

- Wizard resume/state mechanics (mark_done/is_done, prod/setup.sh:70-71)
  used, not reinvented; no existing step script edited.
- The M1-395 reset invariant (do_reset comment, prod/setup.sh:156-165)
  EXTENDED to comfyui (P31) — reset stops every service the wizard may have
  started.
- M1-389 secrets discipline: every compose invocation passes `--env-file`,
  never shell-sources secrets.env (prior art's compose_comfyui wrapper
  shape).
- M1-464 reset-silence posture: stop_comfyui_if_present prints nothing when
  there is nothing to stop.
- M1-797 image invariants through the carve: tmpfs output/temp + janitor +
  TTL env unchanged, no host port added, flags verbatim (P21/P34); the
  docker-compose.gpu.yml and docker-compose.comfyui.yml files are read as
  precedent, never re-shaped.
- ComfyUIClient's template-validation contract is CONSUMED, never edited —
  no Java changes in either ticket; the templates must pass the existing
  validation (P15).
- The 4-llm.sh disclosure-before-commit shape for the firewall text and the
  fetch_gguf skip-if-present precedent for download dedupe.

## Verification strategy

Every pitfall maps to a probe in the owning ticket (shell/docs diffs — no
mvn coverage exists for wizard scripts; the M1-797/M1-798 precedent is
probe-shaped acceptance):

- P15 → M1-798 item: each generated template is validated against the exact
  ComfyUIClient rules (one placeholder, one numeric-seed KSampler); a
  two-placeholder template must fail the check (failure-mode).
- P21 → M1-807 flag grep + M1-797 threshold re-run; M1-798 compose-network-
  only base-url (failure-mode: any host-port addition fails the overlay
  config render probe).
- P22/P26 → M1-798 picker probes: container numbers match the design doc's
  container table; no conda value appears as a container number
  (failure-mode); dead-URL preflight aborts before any download
  (failure-mode); per-profile menu probe (pi/vps never see local —
  failure-mode).
- P24 → switch-path probe: the delete offer enumerates only the previous
  install's files and skips every shared blob (failure-mode: a shared VAE
  or encoder blob must survive).
- P27 → license-label probes over the Krea branch's printed text.
- P28 → M1-807's 2× decode generation probe (node works with the flags) +
  M1-798's ETA probe generation (the FINAL template executes and produces
  an image — execution, not inspection).
- P29 → probe-protocol assertions: unique seeds per run, warm-up discarded
  (script inspection + a fixed-seed run must NOT be the written constant's
  source).
- P30 → remote-path run against a stub URL:
  `grep -c '^infochat.image.steady-state-seconds=' prod/runtime/application.properties`
  prints 0 while `infochat.image.model` prints 1 (failure-mode — review
  finding 1's own evaluation).
- P31 → `awk '/^do_reset\(\)/,/^}/' prod/setup.sh | grep -c
  'docker-compose.comfyui.yml'` ≥ 1, and a reset with comfyui running leaves
  `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.comfyui.yml ps -q
  comfyui` empty (failure-mode — review finding 2's own evaluation).
- P32 → enable-after-not-enabled probe: a directory at the mount source is
  replaced by the file (write side); residual relayed to M1-803.
- P33 → Dockerfile pin grep; no other node added (diff review).
- P34 → Mage-Flow within 2× conda 4.38 s on the rebuilt image; the 2×
  decode probe asserts 896×672 latent → ~1792×1344 output.
- Non-vacuity anchors: removing the STEPS entry fails the reproduction;
  dropping a HEAD check fails the dead-URL probe; omitting the firewall line
  fails its grep; writing the ETA on the remote path fails P30's probe.

## Decomposition

Two tickets; each embeds its slice of this analysis.

- **M1-807 — ComfyUI image carve: VAE-Utils node + flag re-verify**
  (prod/images/comfyui/ + design doc record). blocked_by: none pending.
  Verifiable on the GPU host with the overlay alone. Implements Final
  decision 5's image half.
- **M1-798 — setup-wizard /image step (REWRITE in place, keeps its ID)**
  (prod/scripts/, prod/setup.sh, docker-compose.yml, SETUP_GUIDE.md,
  07-deployment.md, design-doc disk sizes). blocked_by: M1-807 (the Krea
  template and the ETA probe need the node in the image); depends on
  M1-797's overlay (done). Implements D73/D77 + Final decisions 1–5, 7's
  wizard half.

Order: M1-807 → M1-798. M1-803 (handler/converter/guardrail) is OUT of this
analysis by the brief's boundary; it inherits the wizard→handler interface
above, the P32 DECIDE-BEFORE, and the addendum-decision-4 DECIDE-BEFORE.
Fixtures are calibrated to the family end state: M1-807's probes assert the
node + flags the LAST ticket (M1-798) depends on; M1-798's probes assert the
final template/ETA shape, not an interim one.

## SPEC-GAP

None. The spec supports every decision above: D73/D77 already commit to the
config gate, the one-box/two-box forms, and the wizard-printed firewall
requirement (decisions.md:92-96); security.md §Trust boundaries items 8/9
supply the exposure posture; the pipeline content itself (steps, VAEs, fit
stages, numbers, license labels) is design-layer text in
docs/design/future/image-generation.md under the "promote to spec before
implementing v2" header's v1 carve-out — the tickets write operator-facing
config and docs, change no spec promise, and need no amendment. Discrepancy
D-2 (stale future-features.md §B2 paragraph) is a design-record correction,
a follow-up `spec:` commit, not a gap.

## Prior art disposition (falsify, do not adopt)
